t: The Web's Evolving Eyes: From Mobilegeddon to AI's Accessibility Tree
s: The article chronicles the web's evolution from infrastructure battles and the search engine Cambrian explosion to the mobile revolution ('Mobilegeddon') and the current shift towards AI agents. It posits the Accessibility Tree as the crucial new 'viewport' for AI, moving beyond raw HTML to understand rendered reality and function.
sub: Evolution of Search Engines (WebCrawler, AltaVista, Google)
The Accessibility Tree as AI's primary viewport
